method: Same board_surface_playtest.gd policy and seeded builds. Pair by room coordinate within each seed/build; later route/deck divergence prevents causal attribution. Summarize combat_ended joined to combat_started, not reward-screen count.
final_source_differences: Three final equipment cards (Lodestone Reversal, Anchor Slam, Rimeplate Lock) were absent from every candidate deck and play log. Later engine edit extracted the identical lexicographic support comparison into a helper; later save and analytics edits only expose transition context. Focused and full suite passed on final code.
headless_telemetry_limit: Existing manual policy logs omit enemy_action_resolved and leave objective/fog context empty; these runs do not prove intent utilization or Umbra-specific win rates. Focused tests, pursuit probe, structural snapshots and inspected Heart renderer supply scoped evidence instead.
boss_limit: Boss screens use starter gear, 24 HP, no acquired progression; inspect the FIRST combat outcome. The inherited route policy can continue after a boss victory; subsequent deaths are not boss defeats. Noctyrax uses six Radiance spells.
